operator_contract.boundary: At every source-free cube boundary epsilon=epsilon_0, so the published spherical vacuum flux law fixes phi_boundary=phi_Newton_boundary/epsilon_0.
operator_contract.exact_equivalence_rule: Within each source cell, identical epsilon-field hashes are solved once and every registered parameter cell retains an equivalence link.
operator_contract.parameter_policy: The DiskMass universal median is the main fixed published control; eight prior corners are sensitivity cells and cannot be selected from responses.

unit_contract.field_equation_normalization: RHS uses the predecessor G=a0=1 dimensionless density while epsilon is evaluated from the same deposited density converted to physical g cm^-3
